bole.text: Not described by a source read. Latex white (Los Amigos specimen); bitter per Ducke 1939 as cited by Berg 1972.

crown.text: Called a canopy species ('especie de dosel') with high importance value in two Los Amigos floodplain plots.

phenology.fruit: yellow with white dots (Los Amigos specimen, fruiting 21 Aug 2002)

bark.text: Not described by a source read.

habitat.range: Los Amigos / Madre de Dios, SE Peru (sources read); Berg 1972: widespread from Mexico southward, not equally common throughout

notes: Poorly documented in open sources. Vela-Apaza 2024 (src 0): canopy species with high IVI in plots Bajio CM3 and Jacaratia (seasonally flooded floodplain, c. 23 days/yr, Madre de Dios). Atrium specimen Janovec & Maceda 2701 (src 1): 'Tree 30 m. Fruit yellow, with white dots. Latex white', upland terrace terra firme, 270 m; the height and fruiting month are this one tree. Berg 1972 Flora Neotropica 7 (src 2): genus latex white or yellowish; B. lactescens latex bitter (Ducke); staminate flowers may be complete; no species description of size, leaves or fruit on the page read. Search snippets mentioned Acre specimens 24-30 m, DBH 40-80 cm, whitish-grey bark and woolly monkey (Lagothrix cana) feeding at Manu Learning Centre, but those pages could not be read (NYBG verification wall; Field Museum PDF gone), so not entered. No common name found in sources read.
